desktop_release_gate: portal-native-desktop packages every matrix target; GenerateNativeIndex fails unless all three binaries are present (-Pportal.native.requireComplete=true). The CI build-desktop-runtime matrix and final publish job enforce this.
release_gate: Publication requires every provenance and licensing field to be resolved and every generated native artifact to pass its platform verifier.
